text: At its meeting of November 13, 2019 the Planning and Housing Committee considered item PH10.3 - Inclusionary Zoning Public Consultation Comments and Update: http://app.toronto.ca/tmmis/viewAgendaItemHistory.do?item=2019.PH10.3 The Committee's decision on this report included direction to City Planning staff to provide information by February 2020 on matters related to inclusionary zoning and affordable housing. Staff are undertaking work to respond to this request and will be bringing forward a report to the March 23, 2020 meeting of the Planning and Housing Committee.
The Planning and Housing Committee: 1. Received the report (January 29, 2020) from the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning for information.
